stem: Which quotation provides the best evidence that the story takes place in a rural setting?

options.label: A
options.text: On one of our walks, she headed for the bushes.

options.label: B
options.text: When the first frost came in November, Aunt Jessie fretted.

options.label: C
options.text: She reached across the bush in front and touched my plastic rose.

options.label: D
options.text: I ran to the barn, ashamed and confused.
